Subject: HSM signer provisioning & rotation — request to schedule live witness

Alex —

Following our SIG/CAIQ review, our security team needs an auditable demonstration of your tenant HSM signer provisioning and rotation process before we finalize the onboarding checklist. Specifically we want:

- A checklist of the steps your operators run when provisioning a new signing key in an HSM (firmware & module attestation, operator authentication, sealed key import, and initial signing test).
- The artifacts your team can provide as evidence: firmware digest, HSM module attestation report (vendor), ceremony minutes (participant list + TOTP nonce), signed nonce from the new signer, and a sample signing log for a short test vector.
- Confirmation that key rotation can be performed without tenant downtime and the fallback path if a signer fails during rotation.
- A 30–45 minute virtual witness: we want to observe the operator flow and the signing test (remote video + live audit transcript).

Can you: 1) share any existing runbooks or checklists; 2) confirm what artifacts you can deliver ahead of the witness; and 3) propose two time slots next week for a live session (we prefer Eastern time afternoons).

We have a fast audit window and would like to complete this by end of next week if possible. I attached our SIG inventory and a short template of evidence we expect (aurorafin_sig_inventory.xlsx).

Thanks —
Emma Bates
Senior Security Engineer
Aurora Financial
emma.bates@aurorafin.com

Emma —

Thanks for the clear ask and for the template. We can run the virtual witness and provide most of the artifacts you listed. Quick summary of what we'll produce ahead of or during the session: 

- Pre-session deliverables (sent by noon PT day before):
  * redwood_hsm_witness_checklist_v1.2.pdf — our operator checklist with step-by-step actions and expected artifacts
  * rotation-runbook_v3.pdf — the runbook we use for live rotations, including rollback triggers and multi-region fallback
  * sample-signer-test.log — anonymized output from a prior test signing run (no tenant data)
  * HSM firmware digest and vendor attestation (redacted serials where appropriate)

- During the live witness:
  * We will share a single-view Zoom + screen share showing the operator console and HSM vendor UI, and stream the signing test output to your team.
  * Operator identity will be shown (names + short role summary).
  * We will execute an ephemeral test key import, sign a short nonce you provide, and publish the signed nonce and the log transcript to an SFTP drop for evidence collection.

Operational notes: we perform rotations with cross-region warm signers so tenant traffic does not require planned downtime. The runbook documents the exact quorum/rollforward steps and automatic traffic re-route windows.

Proposed slots (ET afternoons as requested):
- Tue, 2029-03-19 15:00–15:45 ET (12:00–12:45 PT)
- Thu, 2029-03-21 16:00–16:45 ET (13:00–13:45 PT)

If those don't work we can offer Wed 14:00 ET as backup. We'll also need a short NDA addendum for the live demo (covers ephemeral signing keys and video capture). I'll attach the checklist and the runbook now so you can review.

Regards,
